name: Amaziah
bio: Amaziah, priest of the royal sanctuary at Bethel, reported Amos to King Jeroboam II as a conspirator for prophesying the king's death and Israel's exile, then ordered Amos to leave and prophesy in Judah instead. Amos replied that the LORD himself had called him from shepherding, and pronounced judgment on Amaziah's own household for trying to silence God's word (Amos 7:10-17). He is a different figure from Amaziah, king of Judah.
